tunnel.description: the Cloudflare Tunnel that reaches a machine from this entity, and the Workers VPC Service the tunnel's gateway reaches it through

id.description: the tunnel's id in the account

service.description: the VPC Service's id, which the tunnel's gateway is bound to

adopted.description: made outside whatever keeps this record, which only records it: removing the record forgets the two ids and never removes or rotates what they name

tunnel_tell.description: tell the platform a tunnel's conversations are held on what a knock at the session standing here for one of them says, as the machine's person, and mark it said: the platform's assistant in that conversation hears it (yaks.app takes it in on its Operator's `machine` channel). A knock names what it tells, so it is told once
